_comment: Template for /data/qqbot/config/onebot.json. Change every CHANGE_ME. SnowLuma OVERWRITES this file on first boot (docs/06-pitfalls.md P-05) - re-copy it after the container is up.

networks._wsClients_comment: Only needed for a reverse-WS consumer such as AstrBot. With SurfCore the bridge connects OUT to ws://snowluma:3001, so this array stays empty. Leaving a dead entry here makes SnowLuma log 'ENOTFOUND astrbot' every 5 seconds.
